project_info.theme: Blue-hour flash portrait on a rocky overlook
project_info.color_palette: dark chocolate brown, dark denim, black, orange-crimson horizon, teal, deep blue

main_subject.type: adult man using a required approved-adult face reference
main_subject.detail: An adult man whose face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression match the attached approved-adult reference. He has very short dark buzz-cut hair, a calm neutral expression, warm undertones, subtle facial imperfections, and natural skin texture. He wears a smooth solid dark-chocolate brown crewneck sweater with a relaxed boxy fit, slightly dropped shoulders, and ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem, paired with loose dark denim jeans and black boots.

items: full-body vertical frame with the subject standing centered on a rock
hands relaxed by his sides and a calm direct gaze
deep dark rocky foreground and subtly silhouetted terrain
distant city lights or coastline barely visible through haze
expansive twilight sky with a warm orange-crimson horizon fading to teal and deep blue

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: dramatic frontal on-camera flash balanced with blue-hour ambient light
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: crisp highlights and hard falloff on the subject while retaining sky color

technical_specs.color_treatment: controlled contrast, rich twilight gradient, natural skin texture, restrained film grain

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a full-body vertical blue-hour portrait of an adult man using the attached approved-adult face reference; preserve his face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression exactly without celebrity or public-figure substitution. He stands centered on a rock with a calm neutral expression, warm undertones, subtle facial imperfections, natural skin texture, and very short dark buzz-cut hair. He wears a solid dark-chocolate brown crewneck sweater with a smooth non-textured surface, medium-heavy structured fabric, relaxed boxy fit, slightly dropped shoulders, and thick ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem, paired with loose dark denim jeans and black boots. Use dramatic frontal on-camera flash with crisp highlights and hard falloff, balanced to preserve an expansive twilight sky: a warm orange and crimson horizon fading into teal and deep blue. Include a deep rocky foreground, subtly silhouetted terrain, and a faint distant city or coastline in haze. Keep the result realistic and cinematic.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, identity blending, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach a required approved-adult face reference. Preserve the adult man's facial identity, buzz cut, brown crewneck sweater, dark jeans, boots, centered rock stance, flash treatment, and blue-hour horizon. Do not use a celebrity/public-figure likeness.

assets.name: approved-adult-face-reference
assets.usage: Keep adult face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression exactly consistent.

changes: Clarified that the reference subject must be an approved adult while preserving the original male portrait, wardrobe, flash, rock setting, and blue-hour mood.
